project.title: The ATM That Printed Tomorrow's Money
project.subtitle: ATM Jo Kal Ka Paisa Deti Thi
project.info: Tagline: Kal koi jagah nahi hai jo milti hai... kal ek jagah hai jo banti hai. Genre: Time-travel suspense / moral twist · Style: Chroma Toons 2D flat cartoon Audio: record narration (Hinglish) → voiceover/vo-full.mp3 (optional, auto-muxed)

scene.title: Midnight, Pahadi Road
scene.caption: Aaj ki raat, ek ladke ne ATM se paise nikale. Lekin jab usne note ko haath mein uthaya... toh note par koi aur hi date chhapi hui thi.

scene.title: TRANSACTION FROM TOMORROW
scene.caption: Kal ki date. Aur woh paisa kaam kar raha tha. Bilkul asli ki tarah. Lekin jo baat aage hone wali thi, usne is shehar ka waqt hi badal ke rakh diya. Yeh hai... Kal Wale ATM ki kahani.

scene.title: Raghu ka kamra
scene.caption: Is kahani ka hero, Raghu. B.Com ka aakhri saal. Din mein delivery karne wala, raat ko padhai. Ghar mein do kamre, ek dawai, aur sau sapne.

scene.title: Aath hazaar ka bill
scene.caption: Jab Amma ki tabiyat kharab hui, doctor ne ₹8,000 ki dawai likhi. Raghu ke paas sirf do sau the. Aur ussi raat woh nikal pada — us purane ATM par.

scene.title: MahaLakshmi Bank — Branch 13
scene.caption: Machine purani thi. Na wiring thi, na koi shop. Lekin screen par light thi. Raghu ne socha — ek baar try karke dekhta hoon. Kya hi hoga?

scene.title: 5000 rupaye, kal ki date
scene.caption: Usne 5000 rupaye nikale. Aur note par likha tha: KAL KI DATE. Raghu ne socha — printing mistake hogi. Lekin woh galat tha. Yeh invitation tha.

scene.title: Paisa kaam kar raha hai
scene.caption: Sabse bada twist yeh tha — paisa kaam kar raha tha. Pharmacy ne accept kiya. Kirana wale ne accept kiya. Auto wale ne bhi.

scene.title: Ek hafte mein ameer
scene.caption: Ek hafte mein Raghu ki zindagi badal gayi. Lekin Kalu Chacha ne note uthaya aur ruk gaye: Beta... yeh note kal ka hai?

scene.title: BREAKING: Notes illegal!
scene.caption: Aadhi raat ko — tees din ki date wale saare notes ek second mein illegal ho gaye. Jinki date aaj hai woh asli. Jinki date kal hai... woh ab jaalsaaz the.

scene.title: Inspector Sher Singh
scene.caption: Inspector: Raghu! Woh note jis pe kal ki date hai — woh note criminal hai! Raghu bhaaga. Jaeb mein woh paisa, jo raat ko asli tha aur ab faaltu.

scene.title: 3:00 AM — wapas
scene.caption: Teen baje woh wapas wahan tha. Machine ne card nahi maanga. Screen par ek shehar dikha — hawa mein gaadiyan, sheeshe ke minaar, aur sabse bada number: 2087.

scene.title: Main koi bank nahi hoon
scene.caption: ATM: Main koi bank nahi hoon, Raghu. Main ek darpan hoon. Aur yeh paisa jo tune nikala... woh paisa nahi hai. Woh waqt hai.

scene.title: TIME POLICE
scene.caption: Screen ki roshni mein ek insaan aaya. Silver coat. Cyan aankhein. Aur haath mein chhota sa card: TIME POLICE. Mera naam Kavya hai. 2087.

scene.title: Raghav — 2087 ka sabse ameer aadmi
scene.caption: Yeh ATM banaya tha Raghav ne — 2087 ka sabse ameer aadmi. Aur woh aadmi... tu hai, Raghu. Har note jo tu aaj kharach karega, woh kisi aur ka kal chura lega.

scene.title: Paisa... ya Amma
scene.caption: Duniya bhar ka paisa, aur ek maa ki dawai. Raghu ke haath kaap rahe the. Phone par Amma ki awaaz: Beta... dawai khatam ho gayi.

scene.title: Kal mera nahi hai
scene.caption: Aur tab Raghu ne woh kiya jo future ke sabse ameer aadmi ne kabhi nahi socha. Usne notes faad diye. Ek-ek karke. Kal ka paisa, aaj ki baarish mein.

scene.title: Tumne aaj chuna
scene.caption: Kavya: Tumne aaj chuna, Raghu. Isliye tumhara kal aayega. ATM golden dust mein bikhar gaya. Subah — Amma ki khansi gayab thi.

scene.title: Ek note — aaj ki date
scene.caption: Uske jaeb mein ek note tha. Date: AAJ KI. Likha tha: Amma theek hai — Tumhara Kal wala Khud. Aur kal... kal ek jagah hai jo banti hai.
